parameters.query:
with organization as (
  select id from public.organizations where slug = $10
),
inserted as (
  insert into public.leads (organization_id, external_id, full_name, email, phone, company,
                            services, timeline, message, estimated_price, source)
  select organization.id, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5,
         array(select jsonb_array_elements_text($6::jsonb)), $7, $8, $9, 'website'
  from organization
  on conflict (organization_id, external_id) do nothing
  returning id
)
select exists (select 1 from organization) as organization_found,
       (select id from inserted) as lead_id;

update public.leads
set score = $1::public.lead_score,
    score_reason = $2,
    draft_subject = $3,
    draft_body = $4
where id = $5::uuid;
